name: tr_kd
caption:
IF KD HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

⚡ Elekid: it loves violent thunder. #2 pick in 2007, then Rookie of the Year
👻 Dusknoir: it carries lost spirits to another world. The Slim Reaper, 4 scoring titles
🐉 Zekrom: it can scorch the world with lightning. MVP with the Thunder in 2014
🫠 Ditto: it turns into a copy of its enemy. Up 3-1 on us in 2016, then he signed with us
🦂 Drapion: its ability is Sniper. Easy Money's go-ahead three in Game 3 of the 2017 Finals, 45.3 seconds left
⚔️ Zacian: the Warrior Pokémon, a legendary hero. 2 titles and 2 Finals MVPs with us, 2017 and 2018

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Kevin Durant had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF KD HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Elekid. It loves violent thunder. The second pick in two thousand seven, then Rookie of the Year.
beats.dlg: IT LOVES VIOLENT THUNDER.|PICK 2, ROOKIE OF THE YEAR

beats.vo: Dusknoir. It's said to carry lost spirits off to another world. They call him the Slim Reaper. Four scoring titles.
beats.dlg: IT CARRIES SPIRITS AWAY.|4 SCORING TITLES!

beats.vo: Zekrom. This legend can scorch the world with lightning. MVP with the Thunder in twenty fourteen.
beats.dlg: IT SCORCHES THE WORLD WITH|LIGHTNING. MVP IN 2014!

beats.vo: Ditto. When it spots an enemy, it turns into an almost perfect copy. He was up three games to one on us. That summer, he became one of us.
beats.dlg: IT COPIES ITS ENEMY.|UP 3-1 ON US. THEN JOINS!

beats.vo: Drapion. Its ability is Sniper. Easy Money. Game three of the Finals, the go-ahead three with forty-five seconds left.
beats.dlg: ITS ABILITY IS SNIPER.|THE GO-AHEAD THREE!

beats.vo: And the ace. Zacian, the Warrior Pokemon, known as a legendary hero. Two titles with us, and two Finals MVPs.
beats.dlg: THE WARRIOR POKEMON!|2 TITLES, 2 FINALS MVPS!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Durant: second (#2) overall pick by the Seattle SuperSonics in the 2007 NBA draft; NBA Rookie of the Year (2008); nicknamed the Slim Reaper; also nicknamed the Easy Money Sniper; four (4) NBA scoring titles; NBA Most Valuable Player (2014) with the Oklahoma City Thunder; OKC led the Warriors 3-1 in the 2016 West finals, then he signed with Golden State in 2016; 2017 Finals: go-ahead 3-pointer with 45.3 seconds left in Game 3; 2x NBA champion and 2x Finals MVP (2017, 2018)
OKC led the record 73-win Warriors 3-1 in the 2016 Western Conference Finals
Dusknoir is said to take lost spirits along with it to worlds unknown
Zekrom: this legendary Pokemon can scorch the world with lightning
Ditto: when it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost perfect copy of its opponent
Zacian: genus Warrior Pokemon; known as a legendary hero
